old_caption: The video opens with a breathtaking view of a mountainous landscape shrouded in mist. The sun is positioned high in the sky, casting a warm, golden light that pierces through the dense fog, creating a dramatic interplay of light and shadow across the terrain. The mountains rise majestically in the background, their peaks partially obscured by the swirling mist. In the foreground, a vast expanse of low-lying vegetation stretches out, its silhouettes barely visible against the misty backdrop. The camera remains static throughout, with the only visible movement being the drift of the mist across the frame, which adds a sense of depth and motion to the scene.
original_wisa_caption:
The video opens with a breathtaking view of a mountainous landscape shrouded in mist. The sun is positioned high in the sky, casting a warm, golden light that pierces through the dense fog, creating a dramatic interplay of light and shadow across the terrain. The mountains rise majestically in the background, their peaks partially obscured by the swirling mist. In the foreground, a vast expanse of low-lying vegetation stretches out, its silhouettes barely visible against the misty backdrop.

As the video progresses, the camera pans slowly to the right, revealing more of the rugged terrain. The mist continues to drift, adding a sense of movement and depth to the scene. The sun's rays filter through the clouds, illuminating patches of the landscape and highlighting the contours of the mountains. The vegetation in the foreground appears to be a mix of shrubs and small trees, their leaves glistening with moisture from the mist.

The camera continues its smooth pan, capturing the serene beauty of
caption: A dark mountain ridge stands silhouetted beneath a bright, overexposed sun positioned near the top center of the frame, while low-lying mist and clouds already drift continuously across and over its slopes. Wisps that hug the incline thicken and shift, their density rising and falling as they translate along the crest, alternately revealing and veiling the ridgeline. The motion is dominated by the fog, since the terrain and the glowing orb remain fixed in place throughout the excerpt. Radiant sunbeams slant downward through the haze, their angle and intensity shifting as the intervening cloud density varies, though no new light source appears or disappears. The left summit grows progressively more obscured as the fog thickens around the middle of the segment, while the right-hand slope, partly veiled at first, becomes more distinctly outlined toward the close. The bright disc itself shows only slight positional drift near the top of the frame. Foreground vegetation along the bottom stays fixed. The fog keeps moving.
